ideas.label: Outpost
ideas.principle: Convert a stable square into activity
ideas.summary: An outpost is a useful square that cannot be challenged safely by an enemy pawn. Occupy it with a piece that creates concrete threats.

ideas.label: Outpost
ideas.principle: Match the outpost to the right piece
ideas.summary: Pawn structure determines outposts. A supported knight is especially strong when it attacks weaknesses on both wings and cannot be exchanged by the opponent's favorable minor piece.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]

ideas.label: Outpost
ideas.summary: Before installing a knight on a central outpost, prevent the pawn break that would undermine its support and compare the opponent's exchange options. If the knight also blocks an IQP, it should pressure adjacent squares rather than become a passive guard.
